column2: What was happening in the world during my ancestor’s life?
column3: On the record, the “🌍 The world around” block puts their life next to the major events in France and the world (wars, epidemics, laws, inventions, regimes, mostly 1500–1960) with their age: “Jean is 38 when the war of 1870 begins”. Local events (department, commune) only appear if they lived there. “＋ Add a local event” for a flood, a fire, a village fête. The whole list and the source of each event: Lists → History → “🌍 The world around”. The Timeline shows them too (“Historical timeline” box).

column2: What did a clog-maker, a day labourer, a weaver do?
column3: On the record, click the occupation (Identity → “Occupation / activity”, it has a 🛠️): the occupation’s page opens — what they did, their tools, the old words, the ancestors who practised it (list, map, timeline) and the images in your database about it. “✎ Complete the page”, “＋ Add images” or “📒 Make it a Note” to enrich it. The complete dictionary (more than 500 occupations with their spelling variants): Lists → People and families → “🛠️ Old occupations”.

column2: How do I see my ancestors’ occupations in a tree (🧬 Occupation tree)?
column3: Charts → “Occupation tree” (or, on a record, ⋯ → “🧬 Occupation tree”; or ⌘K “occupations”). Choose the person in the “Person” box, then “⬆ Ancestors” or “⬇ Descendants” and the number of generations. Each box shows their occupations (record, “Occupation” events, censuses), with a colour per broad sector: agriculture, crafts, industry, trade, transport, services, army, clergy, liberal professions… (the classification comes from the dictionary of old occupations). A thick coloured line and “＝ same occupation”: the child took over their parent’s occupation; “⇄ other occupation”: they changed; dotted lines: one of the two has no occupation recorded. At the top: filter by sector (badges with the number) or search for an occupation; “🔒 Without living people or confidential records” to show or print. At the bottom: the legend and “Passing on the occupation” — the share of sons who took over their father’s occupation (and of daughters their mother’s), by century, in the tree and in your whole database. A click on a box opens the record. “⤓ Export”: PDF, PNG, JPG, SVG or 🖨 Print.

column2: How do I see all the places of a person’s life on an animated map (🗺 Life map)?
column3: On the record: ⋯ → “🗺 Map of their life”; or Map → left column → “🗺 Life map” (in Route mode: “▶ Animated life map”); or ⌘K “life map”. Their events (birth, baptism, marriages, residences, occupations, death…), their censuses, their journeys, their placements, their military service and their schools (🎓 block) become numbered stages, in date order, on a map background supplied with the app (no Internet needed). ▶ starts playback (⏸ to stop, speed 🐢 / Normal / 🐇), ◀ ▶ move from one stage to the next, ⤢ shows the whole life; the timeline at the bottom and the list on the right are clickable. Places without a position are listed separately (open the place and give its position so that it comes onto the map). “👪 With the family” adds the spouse and the children (in pink and green). “🎬 Export as video” makes an MP4 or WebM video of the stages, with a copy in the media if you like; living people and confidential records are never in it. “📊 Keep as a diagram” stores it in My diagrams (the “Storytelling map”).

column2: How do I tell a life story as a slideshow?
column3: On the record, click ✨ (or Presentation and slideshow → “✨ Life story”). Choose the person, the length, the style, the photos and music if you like. The slideshow prepares itself from the record: birth on a map, baptism, marriage, children, occupations, censuses, moves, events of the time, death, grave, descendants. Missing information does not produce a slide. Everything can be changed afterwards.

column2: What are a slide’s notes?
column3: Reminders for you, for example the sources of the story. They are not visible during playback and become the speaker’s notes in a presentation.

column2: How do I export a slideshow, a sound or a video edit?
column3: “⤓ Export ▾” at the top: a single window for all formats (video, images, PDF, MP3, WAV…). Tick “Also keep a copy in the media” to keep it in the app.

column2: How do I drag a file into a tool?
column3: Drag (or paste with ⌘V) a photo or a sound onto the slideshow, the presentation, the video edit, the sound waveform, the image of a record, the drawing or the page layout: it goes into the media and is placed in the tool.

column2: How do I export a table, a diagram or a chart?
column3: Click “⤓ Export”: a single window offers PDF, PNG or JPG image, SVG (diagrams), Print, or the tool’s file. Choose the quality and the file name, and tick “Also keep a copy in the media”.

column2: Why can’t I make a PNG image of a chart?
column3: The browser (Chrome, Edge, the app) refuses to turn an app chart into an image. Choose “PDF” in the export window: the file is sharp, to print or to send.

column2: Can I drag files instead of choosing them?
column3: Yes: in “Add media”, on a table, an investigation, the photos of a collection, the favourite image on the dashboard, the file areas of records and in the tools (drawing, page layout, retouching, slideshow, video editing). The area turns blue on hover; you can also paste (⌘V). A .csv file dragged onto a collection’s spreadsheet fills the cells.

column2: How do I choose a font?
column3: The “Aa All fonts…” button opens a single list: search, recent fonts at the top, fonts from the app and from the computer, each written in its own font.

column2: How do I sort a list?
column3: At the top of the list: “N items · Sort:” and the menu (newest, oldest, A → Z…). At the bottom, “See the next N ↓” loads the rest.

column2: How do I create my own theme (colour design)?
column3: Settings → Appearance → “✎ My themes” → “＋ New theme…” (or “Duplicate” on an existing theme). Choose while looking at the preview: the main colour (buttons, links), the background of the page, of panels and of cards, the text, the colour of the lines around frames and their thickness (from 0 to 8 px; 0 = no lines). Tick “Dark theme” for a dark background: the app switches to dark mode. If the text is hard to read on a background, a yellow message says so. Save: it is added to the “Preset” list, in “✎ My themes”; choose it then “Apply”. “⚙️ Manage the presets” arranges, shows or hides themes, and for yours: edit, rename, duplicate, export, delete (with “↶ Undo”).

column2: Why “⚠️ On this background, this colour is hard to read” under “Main colour”?
column3: The main colour is also used to write links, small badges and texts. With some backgrounds (especially a dark theme and a dark colour, such as blue #0066cc on “Dark”), it is hard to read: the app measures the difference in brightness (the contrast, as in “✎ My themes”) and warns when it is below 4.5. It is only a warning: your colour stays chosen. “Use the theme’s colour” puts back the one suggested by the Preset (saved straight away, “↶ Undo” to go back). The warning goes away by itself as soon as the colour or the Preset reads well. In Charts → Statistics, in dark mode, figures written in a statistic’s colour are lightened to stay readable; the bars keep your colours.

column2: How do I change the thickness or colour of the lines around frames?
column3: With a theme of your own: Settings → Appearance → “✎ My themes” → “＋ New theme…” (or “Edit”). “Lines around (borders)” gives their colour, separate from the text colour, and the “Thickness of the lines around” slider their thickness, from 0 to 12 px (2 px at first, double-click to go back to it). The app’s themes keep their 2 px black lines.

column2: How do I add my own avatar shape?
column3: Settings → “Portraits and avatars” → “1 · The shape” → “＋ Create a shape”. Three ways: “📚 Library” (the shapes of the tables: hearts, coats of arms, stars, trees… with search and families), “✏️ Draw a polygon” (click to place the points, drag them, double-click to remove one; triangle, star, shield templates…), or “⤒ Import an SVG” (drag or paste the file: only its filled paths are kept, never a script). Give it a name and “＋ Create the shape”: it is chosen straight away, and stays in the row of shapes (with ✎).

column2: How do I have the same portrait (circle or square of initials) everywhere?
column3: Settings → “Portraits and avatars”. “1 · The shape”: one shape for everything (circle, rounded square, square, tilted square, diamond… and yours), which applies to portraits and to the small numbered squares of the blocks; it is saved as soon as you click. “2 · The portrait”: “Start from” As before (at first, each screen keeps its own drawing), Single circle (the same circle everywhere, in the colour of the gender) or Record square (black border, photo in black and white). Below: rounding, size of initials, border, colours for man / woman / unknown / animal, the record’s photo, black and white, one or two letters, Sosa badge; the preview shows the record, a list, the picker, the tree and the badges. “↺ Reset to default” goes back to “As before”.

column2: How do I change the left column (style of entries, numbers, tabs, width, on the right)?
column3: Settings → “Menus, column and lists” → “Column” tab. “Where?”: left or right. “The column’s design”: “Start from” As before (at first) or New (consecutive numbers, the same tabs everywhere, “List | Cards” above the list), then each choice as a picture: style of entries (framed buttons by default, continuous list, airy list, buttons without shadow, side bar, rounded badges, binder tabs, cards with a marker, soft background), top tabs, numbers (consecutive, original letters or none), size, “List | Cards” and width (240 to 420 px). The preview follows each click. It applies to all the columns (People, Charts, Map, Investigations, Research, Comparison…).

column2: How do I change the shape of the app’s elements (rounded corners, thin lines, plain, compact…)?
column3: There is no longer a “Designs to choose from” page: each shape is stored where it is used. The style of records (lines, shadows, corners: As before, Soft, Old paper, Plain) in Settings → “Person and animal records”, with the shape of the header: it only changes the records of people and animals; the lines, corners and shadows of the left column in “Menus, column and lists” → Column; the page background in “Theme and colours” (🧩 Page background); Movements in Settings → “♿ Accessibility” → “🎞 Movement” tab; Density, Icons and Lists in Settings → “Menus, column and lists” (one tab each); Buttons at the end of “Notifications and buttons”; the header of records in “Person and animal records” → “Shape of the header”; the boxes of trees in Charts → “🎨 Colours of statistics and trees”. For each: click the large card you prefer (👍 / 👎 to help you), then fine-tune in “More settings”; the preview shows real screens of the app with your data. It is saved straight away (“✓ Saved”), with “↶ Undo”. The font, the text size and the colours are set in “Theme and colours”.
